source.name: Atalanta BC — Atalanta's shirt sponsors for the 2026/27 campaign
source.quote: Featuring prominently on the front of the jersey will be, once again, our Main Sponsor LETE, a market leader in carbonated natural mineral water.

source.name: Atalanta BC — Atalanta's shirt sponsors for the 2026/27 campaign
source.quote: The Second Shirt Sponsor will be SNAIFUN, the app created by Snai that rewards a passion for sport and culture through news, quizzes and predictions.
source.note: The club page gives Snaifun the Second Shirt Sponsor role; Prima Bergamo (15 Dec 2025) places the logo on the abdomen, directly beneath the main sponsor Lete.

source.name: Atalanta BC — Atalanta's shirt sponsors for the 2026/27 campaign
source.quote: Sporting its logo beneath the shirt number, our Back-of-shirt Sponsor GEWISS has renewed its support for Atalanta.

source.name: Atalanta BC — Atalanta's shirt sponsors for the 2026/27 campaign
source.quote: In its second season in Nerazzurri colours, NEW BALANCE completes the lineup as Official Kit Sponsor.
source.note: Kit maker, named by the club as part of the shirt lineup; not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense.

summary: New Balance home shirt: Lete on the front, Snaifun directly beneath it, Gewiss beneath the shirt number on the back. Lete is family-owned (SGAM), Snaifun is the Snai app (Snaitech, Flutter), Gewiss sits in the Bosatelli family's Polifin holding; no state owner found in any chain.
